prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Waiting Screen Step: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after the waiting screen, after pet assets have finished generating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Voice Preview Companion Flow: Adds an interactive audio voice sample component to companion choices on the pick friend screen.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Listen to Voice Preview", "asset": "asset:companion_voice", "action": "play"}]}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into a clean two-column layout contrasting preset companion adoption against custom photo upload.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "two_column"}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Upload Pre-flight Verification Screen: Inserts a dedicated image quality verification screen right after photo upload before sending photos to render.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_verify", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_verify": {"headline": "Verify Photo Quality", "body": "Ensure your pet photo is clear before starting generation.", "button_label": "Confirm Photo"}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Display Redesign: Rebuild the pet selection interface using a grid layout that displays all available companions simultaneously.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid"}}
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Audio Chime Notification: Triggers a audio completion chime when pet asset creation finishes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:completion_chime", "action": "play"}]}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Estimate Progress Display: Displays an estimated time countdown timer component on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "subtle"}]}}
7: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Compact View Layout: Update the story screen to use a compact layout for faster initial browsing.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact"}}
8: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Mastery Badge Incentive: Display an exclusive onboarding completion badge on the final intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Mastery Collector Badge", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Full Bleed Experience Redesign: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed"}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after the waiting screen within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Adding an audio voice preview component to the pick friend screen is allowed.
Redesigning the choose path screen layout while retaining both options is permitted.
Adding a photo quality verification screen inside onboarding sub-flows is allowed.
Rebuilding the pick friend interface with a grid layout is allowed.
Adding an audio completion chime to the waiting screen is permitted.
Displaying a countdown timer on the waiting screen for a real wait is allowed.
Updating the story screen layout to a compact view is permitted.
Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras, gifts, or completion badges.
Redesigning the home intro overlay layout is permitted inside onboarding.
